model.what a player picks: MP is class-based: Scout (car), Scientist (jet), Soldier (tank), Leader (truck). In custom mode the player builds a character on a chassis (body) of their class and faction and customizes colours, weapons, abilities; in iconic mode (playlist OnlyAllowIconicCharacters / GameTeamStatus 2 or 4) the player picks a preset iconic character. Both use the chassis ROBODEF.
model.faction_note: FactionRestriction 0 Autobot, 1 Decepticon, 3 Neutral (config); iconic presets list a chassis per faction, so the same iconic character can appear on either team in iconic mode (e.g. AirRaid -> Jet4 for both)
